title: Extract delegation wait and server-instance recovery from frontend command facade
outcome: Current-tree audit 2026-09-22: ui/src/delegation-commands.ts is 1,800 lines and combines composer request policy, spawn/reviewer batches, basic commands, bounded polling waits, backend resume registration and server-instance recovery grouping. Extract waitDelegationsWithTransport with fetchStatusBatchWithDeadline and its status-batch/recovery helpers into an owning module, with matching deadline/cancellation/restart tests from delegation-commands.test.ts. Keep backend-scheduled resume waits distinct from polling and preserve createDelegationCommands public facade. No existing open task covers this frontend boundary; tm-kds and tm-rl10 cover backend result subsystems.
acceptance: Pure move plus module wiring, stable exported command/result contracts and ordering. Preserve overall deadline, abort propagation, mixed-instance recovery, partial results and zero duplicate requests. No new polling or changed timeout constants. Focused tests preserve inventory and pass via maintained launcher; document module ownership and avoid circular dependency through the facade.
